title: Block Inventory
description: Schema for blocks/inventory.json — machine-readable catalog of parametric building blocks

name.description: Unique kebab/snake-case identifier referenced in BUILD_PLAN.json blocks_needed

kind.description: Entry family: a library block, an archetype template (one whole-part entry), or a step primitive

module.description: Python dotted module path, e.g. blocks.fasteners

probes.description: Probe function in the same module: probes(**params) -> list[probes.Probe] in the entry's local frame

edge_sets.description: Edge-set name -> description; the module's <function>_edge_sets(**params) returns each set's local-frame curves for the finishing pass

optional.description: Params a plan instance may omit (the function has a default)

defaults.description: Complete parameter values for the entry's default build (inventory probe test)

use.description: Plain-English description of purpose and when to select this block

motion.description: Relative movement the joint permits after assembly (selection axis). Omit for non-joint blocks.

reversible.description: Whether the joint separates non-destructively at its default fit (selection axis). Set by the clearance regime; records the default.

carries.description: Load directions the joint transmits across the seam, e.g. shear-xy, lock-z. Supports anisotropy-driven split selection.

dof.description: Intrinsic degree of freedom for kinematic range validation. Omit for blocks with no rigid DOF (non-joints, flexures such as living_hinge). Axis is a block-coordinate vector; unit is derived from type (deg for revolute/spherical, mm for prismatic). mechanical_limit is a nominal sanity bound; the geometry sweep is authoritative for a specific instance.

direction.description: Block-coordinate motion axis vector: rotation axis (revolute), slide direction (prismatic). Sign sets the positive sense by the right-hand rule.

origin.description: Block-coordinate point on the rotation axis (the pivot). Required for revolute; omitted for prismatic (translation is position-independent).

mechanical_limit.description: Nominal full range [lo, hi] in the derived unit

supplied_hardware.description: Non-printed item the user must supply for this block to function, e.g. 'self-tapping screw'. Omit for a block with no such dependency. Drives plan.py's advisory bom-coverage check.

emits.description: For a matched-pair block whose function returns a dict[str, Workplane] of two member unions: their exact ids (e.g. ["leaf_a", "leaf_b"]). Omit for a block that returns a single Workplane. Backs a BUILD_PLAN.json `joints` entry's member cross-check.

params.description: Map of parameter name to unit string (e.g. {d_screw: mm})

oneOf.description: Typical bounding box [w_mm, d_mm, h_mm] for inventory display

interfaces.description: Physical connection points on this block

type.description: Connection kind. Mating docks (face_mount, snap_hook, snap_socket, finger, mortise, tenon, dowel, pin, socket, ...) join this block to a SEPARATELY PRINTED part across an assembly seam; kinematic axes (axis, joint_axis, ball, ball_socket, ...) define a moving joint -- joint_axis is the motion-agnostic kinematic-axis reference (rotation axis, translation axis, or pivot center), with the motion kind read from the block's dof.type; 'union' marks a face/region where the block is rigidly fused (boolean-unioned) into its parent part's body -- one printed rigid body, no seam, no motion.

origin.description: Interface point in block-local coordinates [x, y, z] mm
